question: Tell me about Meridian Assistant

paragraphs.text: A Discord assistant that answers from a brand-scoped document library with sources, and drafts proposal estimates that render only after an explicit stored approval.

paragraphs.label: My contribution
paragraphs.text: I designed and built the whole project myself, using AI-assisted tools (Cursor and Spec Kit) to draft and revise code and tests, which I reviewed.

paragraphs.label: A limitation
paragraphs.text: The evaluation suite uses a scripted model and stand-in embeddings, so it does not measure live answer quality or real retrieval ranking.

question: Tell me about Resume Analyzer

paragraphs.text: Only the first 4,000 characters of a résumé are sent to the AI parser, so longer résumés are only partly parsed.
